title: Bharata requests Rama to accept the kingdom
introduction: Bharata requests Rama to oblige him by accepting the kingdom of Ayodhya, being offered by him back to Rama with the concurrence of Kaikeyi, eventhough bestowed on him by their deceased father. Rama consoles Bharata, saying that death is inevitable for living beings and they should not grieve for their deceased father. Rama asks Bharata to control his grief and go back to Ayodhya to shoulder the burden of rulership there in order to the command of their deceased father and that Rama himself would obey his father's command by staying back in the forest.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे पञ्चोत्तरशततमः सर्गः
Thus completes 105th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
ततः पुरुष सिम्हानाम् वृतानाम् तैः सुहृद् गणैः |
शोचताम् एव रजनी दुह्खेन व्यत्यवर्तत
verses.iast:
tataḥ puruṣa simhānām vṛtānām taiḥ suhṛd gaṇaiḥ |
śocatām eva rajanī duhkhena vyatyavartata
verses.translation: While those lions among men amidst a host of friends were lamenting, that night elapsed with a much difficulty.

verses.devanagari:
रजन्याम् सुप्रभातायाम् भ्रातरः ते सुहृद् वृताः |
मन्दाकिन्याम् हुतम् जप्यम् कृत्वा रामम् उपागमन्
verses.iast:
rajanyām suprabhātāyām bhrātaraḥ te suhṛd vṛtāḥ |
mandākinyām hutam japyam kṛtvā rāmam upāgaman
verses.translation: When the beautiful dawn broke, Rama's brothers along with their companions, having made their offerings and recited their prayers on the banks of River Madakini, approached Rama.

verses.devanagari:
तूष्णीम् ते समुपासीना न कश्चित् किंचिद् अब्रवीत् |
भरतः तु सुहृन् मध्ये राम वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tūṣṇīm te samupāsīnā na kaścit kiṃcid abravīt |
bharataḥ tu suhṛn madhye rāma vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: Sitting in silence, no one uttered a word. Bharata, on his part, amidst his companions, addressed Rama as follows:

verses.devanagari:
सान्त्विता मामिका माता दत्तम् राज्यम् इदम् मम |
तद् ददामि तव एव अहम् भुन्क्ष्व राज्यम् अकण्टकम्
verses.iast:
sāntvitā māmikā mātā dattam rājyam idam mama |
tad dadāmi tava eva aham bhunkṣva rājyam akaṇṭakam
verses.translation: "My mother has been consoled (by you) by giving this kingdom to me. I am giving back that kingdom to you. Enjoy it without hindrance!"

verses.devanagari:
महता इव अम्बु वेगेन भिन्नः सेतुर् जल आगमे |
दुरावारम् त्वद् अन्येन राज्य खण्डम् इदम् महत्
verses.iast:
mahatā iva ambu vegena bhinnaḥ setur jala āgame |
durāvāram tvad anyena rājya khaṇḍam idam mahat
verses.translation: "As a dam breached by a great on-rush of water during a rainy season cannot be repaired so easily, this great continent cannot be defended by any one other than you."

glosses.meaning: by any one other than you.

verses.devanagari:
गतिम् खर इव अश्वस्य तार्क्ष्यस्य इव पतत्रिणः |
अनुगन्तुम् न शक्तिर् मे गतिम् तव मही पते
verses.iast:
gatim khara iva aśvasya tārkṣyasya iva patatriṇaḥ |
anugantum na śaktir me gatim tava mahī pate
verses.translation: "As a donkey cannot emulate the tempo of a horse, or an ordinary bird the movement of Garuda (a kind of falcon), neither can I follow in your footsteps, O, Lord of the world!"

verses.devanagari:
सुजीवम् नित्यशः तस्य यः परैर् उपजीव्यते |
राम तेन तु दुर्जीवम् यः परान् उपजीवति
verses.iast:
sujīvam nityaśaḥ tasya yaḥ parair upajīvyate |
rāma tena tu durjīvam yaḥ parān upajīvati
verses.translation: "O, Rama! Know his life to be blessed forever, on whom others depend Life is, however, difficult for him who depends on others for this life."

verses.devanagari:
यथा तु रोपितो वृक्षः पुरुषेण विवर्धितः |
ह्रस्वकेन दुरारोहो रूढ स्कन्धो महा द्रुमः
स यदा पुष्पितो भूत्वा फलानि न विदर्शयेत् |
स ताम् न अनुभवेत् प्रीतिम् यस्य हेतोः प्रभावितः
एषा उपमा महा बाहो त्वम् अर्थम् वेत्तुम् अर्हसि |
यदि त्वम् अस्मान् ऋषभो भर्ता भृत्यान् न शाधि हि
verses.iast:
yathā tu ropito vṛkṣaḥ puruṣeṇa vivardhitaḥ |
hrasvakena durāroho rūḍha skandho mahā drumaḥ
sa yadā puṣpito bhūtvā phalāni na vidarśayet |
sa tām na anubhavet prītim yasya hetoḥ prabhāvitaḥ
eṣā upamā mahā bāho tvam artham vettum arhasi |
yadi tvam asmān ṛṣabho bhartā bhṛtyān na śādhi hi
verses.translation: "As a tree planted by a man may grow and with its great branches and immense trunk, become inaccessible to a dwarf, yet though it may come to flowering, does not bear fruit, it yeilds no pleasure for him. O, mighty armed! You ought to understand the import of theis simile and being the distinguished Lord of all, may you guide us, your sevants!"

verses.devanagari:
श्रेणयः त्वाम् महा राज पश्यन्तु अग्र्याः च सर्वशः |
प्रतपन्तम् इव आदित्यम् राज्ये स्थितम् अरिम् दमम्
verses.iast:
śreṇayaḥ tvām mahā rāja paśyantu agryāḥ ca sarvaśaḥ |
pratapantam iva ādityam rājye sthitam arim damam
verses.translation: "O, emperor, the conqueror of foes! May all behold you, shining resplendent on all sides like the sun, seated on the throne!"

verses.devanagari:
तव अनुयाने काकुत्ष्थ मत्ता नर्दन्तु कुञ्जराः |
अन्तः पुर गता नार्यो नन्दन्तु सुसमाहिताः
verses.iast:
tava anuyāne kākutṣtha mattā nardantu kuJṇjarāḥ |
antaḥ pura gatā nāryo nandantu susamāhitāḥ
verses.translation: "O, Rama! May the elephants, intoxicated with ichor be heard trumpeting on the highway, when you do return and the women of the inner apartments rejoice, all happily joined together."

glosses.meaning: (on the highway) when you do return

verses.devanagari:
तस्य साधु इत्य् अमन्यन्त नागरा विविधा जनाः |
भरतस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रामम् प्रत्यनुयाचतः
verses.iast:
tasya sādhu ity amanyanta nāgarā vividhā janāḥ |
bharatasya vacaḥ śrutvā rāmam pratyanuyācataḥ
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Bharata, who was thus appealing to Rama, the various people of the city in approbation, said "Excellent! Well said!"

verses.devanagari:
तम् एवम् दुह्खितम् प्रेक्ष्य विलपन्तम् यशस्विनम् |
रामः कृत आत्मा भरतम् समाश्वासयद् आत्मवान्
verses.iast:
tam evam duhkhitam prekṣya vilapantam yaśasvinam |
rāmaḥ kṛta ātmā bharatam samāśvāsayad ātmavān
verses.translation: On seeing the illustrious and sorrowful Bharata thus lamenting, the prudent and self-conposed Rama began to console him as follows:

verses.devanagari:
न आत्मनः काम कारो अस्ति पुरुषो अयम् अनीश्वरः |
इतः च इतरतः च एनम् कृत अन्तः परिकर्षति
verses.iast:
na ātmanaḥ kāma kāro asti puruṣo ayam anīśvaraḥ |
itaḥ ca itarataḥ ca enam kṛta antaḥ parikarṣati
verses.translation: "Man is not able to do what he wills. He is not the Master A fixed form or name drives him hither and thither."

verses.devanagari:
सर्वे क्षय अन्ता निचयाः पतन अन्ताः समुग्च्छ्रयाः |
सम्योगा विप्रयोग अन्ता मरण अन्तम् च जीवितम्
verses.iast:
sarve kṣaya antā nicayāḥ patana antāḥ samugcchrayāḥ |
samyogā viprayoga antā maraṇa antam ca jīvitam
verses.translation: "All that is piled up, is finally disbursed. What rises, ends in a fall. Unio ends in separation. Life ends in death."

verses.devanagari:
यथा फलानम् पक्वानाम् न अन्यत्र पतनाद् भयम् |
एवम् नरस्य जातस्य न अन्यत्र मरणाद् भयम्
verses.iast:
yathā phalānam pakvānām na anyatra patanād bhayam |
evam narasya jātasya na anyatra maraṇād bhayam
verses.translation: "How a ripe fruit does not fear for anything other than its falling, so also a man once born, does not fear for anything other than his death."

verses.devanagari:
यथा अगारम् दृढ स्थूणम् जीर्णम् भूत्वा अवसीदति |
तथा अवसीदन्ति नरा जरा मृत्यु वशम् गताः
verses.iast:
yathā agāram dṛḍha sthūṇam jīrṇam bhūtvā avasīdati |
tathā avasīdanti narā jarā mṛtyu vaśam gatāḥ
verses.translation: "As a house that is solidly contructed ultimately falls into decay, human being too is subject to age and death."

glosses.meaning: having been subjected to the old age and death.

verses.devanagari:
अत्येति रजनी या तु सा न प्रतिनिवर्तते |
यात्येव यमुना पूर्णा समुद्रमुदकाकुलम्
verses.iast:
atyeti rajanī yā tu sā na pratinivartate |
yātyeva yamunā pūrṇā samudramudakākulam
verses.translation: "The night that has passed, does not return and the buntiful River Yamuna just marches on towards the all-sufficient abounding in water."

verses.devanagari:
अहो रात्राणि गग्च्छन्ति सर्वेषाम् प्राणिनाम् इह |
आयूम्षि क्षपयन्त्य् आशु ग्रीष्मे जलम् इव अंशवः
verses.iast:
aho rātrāṇi gagcchanti sarveṣām prāṇinām iha |
āyūmṣi kṣapayanty āśu grīṣme jalam iva aṃśavaḥ
verses.translation: "The pasing days and nights in this world quickly decrease the life-span of all living being as in the summer, the rays of the sun dry up the water (in a pool)."

verses.devanagari:
आत्मानम् अनुशोच त्वम् किम् अन्यम् अनुशोचसि |
आयुः ते हीयते यस्य स्थितस्य च गतस्य च
verses.iast:
ātmānam anuśoca tvam kim anyam anuśocasi |
āyuḥ te hīyate yasya sthitasya ca gatasya ca
verses.translation: "You grieve for yourself. Why do you grieve for another? Even while you stay at home, or departed to another place, your life-span gets shortened."

verses.devanagari:
सह एव मृत्युर् व्रजति सह मृत्युर् निषीदति |
गत्वा सुदीर्घम् अध्वानम् सह मृत्युर् निवर्तते
verses.iast:
saha eva mṛtyur vrajati saha mṛtyur niṣīdati |
gatvā sudīrgham adhvānam saha mṛtyur nivartate
verses.translation: "Death walks just with us (as we walk) and sits with us (as we sit). Having travelled a very long distance (with us), death returns along with us (as we return)."

verses.devanagari:
गात्रेषु वलयः प्राप्ताः श्वेताः चैव शिरो रुहाः |
जरया पुरुषो जीर्णः किम् हि कृत्वा प्रभावयेत्
verses.iast:
gātreṣu valayaḥ prāptāḥ śvetāḥ caiva śiro ruhāḥ |
jarayā puruṣo jīrṇaḥ kim hi kṛtvā prabhāvayet
verses.translation: "When folds have appeared on limbs and hair have turned grey; on what expedient can a man having got decayed with age, come back to the original splendour?"

verses.devanagari:
नन्दन्त्य् उदित आदित्ये नन्दन्त्य् अस्तम् इते रवौ |
आत्मनो न अवबुध्यन्ते मनुष्या जीवित क्षयम्
verses.iast:
nandanty udita āditye nandanty astam ite ravau |
ātmano na avabudhyante manuṣyā jīvita kṣayam
verses.translation: "People are deligted when the sun has risen and also when the day ends. But they are not able to perceive the waning in their life-span."

glosses.meaning: and are not able to know

verses.devanagari:
हृष्यन्त्य् ऋतु मुखम् दृष्ट्वा नवम् नवम् इह आगतम् |
ऋतूनाम् परिवर्तेन प्राणिनाम् प्राण सम्क्षयः
verses.iast:
hṛṣyanty ṛtu mukham dṛṣṭvā navam navam iha āgatam |
ṛtūnām parivartena prāṇinām prāṇa samkṣayaḥ
verses.translation: "Seeing the onset of season, people rejoice, as though it has come something newly. But the succession of the seasons devours the life of being."

verses.devanagari:
यथा काष्ठम् च काष्ठम् च समेयाताम् महा अर्णवे |
समेत्य च व्यपेयाताम् कालम् आसाद्य कंचन
एवम् भार्याः च पुत्राः च ज्नातयः च वसूनि च |
समेत्य व्यवधावन्ति ध्रुवो ह्य् एषाम् विना भवः
verses.iast:
yathā kāṣṭham ca kāṣṭham ca sameyātām mahā arṇave |
sametya ca vyapeyātām kālam āsādya kaṃcana
evam bhāryāḥ ca putrāḥ ca jnātayaḥ ca vasūni ca |
sametya vyavadhāvanti dhruvo hy eṣām vinā bhavaḥ
verses.translation: "As pieces of drift-wood floating on the ocean coe toghether for a span, so wives, children, kinsmen wealth and property come together for a while and part with us. Their parting in deed inevitable."

verses.devanagari:
न अत्र कश्चिद् यथा भावम् प्राणी समभिवर्तते |
तेन तस्मिन् न सामर्थ्यम् प्रेतस्य अस्त्य् अनुशोचतः
verses.iast:
na atra kaścid yathā bhāvam prāṇī samabhivartate |
tena tasmin na sāmarthyam pretasya asty anuśocataḥ
verses.translation: "Here, no being can escape its destiny ( in the form of birth and death). For that reason, the power to avert his own death does not ingrain in a man mourning for a dead person."

glosses.meaning: its destiny (in the form of birth and death)

verses.devanagari:
यथा हि सार्थम् गग्च्छन्तम् ब्रूयात् कश्चित् पथि स्थितः |
अहम् अप्य् आगमिष्यामि पृष्ठतो भवताम् इति
एवम् पूर्वैर् गतो मार्गः पितृ पैतामहो ध्रुवः |
तम् आपन्नः कथम् शोचेद् यस्य न अस्ति व्यतिक्रमः
verses.iast:
yathā hi sārtham gagcchantam brūyāt kaścit pathi sthitaḥ |
aham apy āgamiṣyāmi pṛṣṭhato bhavatām iti
evam pūrvair gato mārgaḥ pitṛ paitāmaho dhruvaḥ |
tam āpannaḥ katham śoced yasya na asti vyatikramaḥ
verses.translation: "As a caravan is passing on a road, one stationed at the way-side says, I too will come behind you. In the same manner, we should inevitably follow the path taken by fathers and fire fathers. Why a man who obtained that path, for which there is no return, distress himself.

verses.devanagari:
वयसः पतमानस्य स्रोतसो वा अनिवर्तिनः |
आत्मा सुखे नियोक्तव्यः सुख भाजः प्रजाः स्मृताः
verses.iast:
vayasaḥ patamānasya srotaso vā anivartinaḥ |
ātmā sukhe niyoktavyaḥ sukha bhājaḥ prajāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: "While the age reshes on, without any return like a flowing river, one's self should be emplyoed in a pursuit leading to blessedness. It is said that beings are meant to be happy?"

glosses.meaning: in a pursuit leading to blessedness

verses.devanagari:
धर्म आत्मा स शुभैः कृत्स्नैः क्रतुभिः च आप्त दक्षिणैः |
धूत पापो गतः स्वर्गम् पिता नः पृथिवी पतिः
verses.iast:
dharma ātmā sa śubhaiḥ kṛtsnaiḥ kratubhiḥ ca āpta dakṣiṇaiḥ |
dhūta pāpo gataḥ svargam pitā naḥ pṛthivī patiḥ
verses.translation: "The king Dasaratha, our pious minded father performed almost all auspicious sacrifices and paid plentiful sacrificial fees (to the officitaing preists and Brahmins) and went to heaven."

glosses.meaning: and paid plentiful sacrificial fees (to the officiating priests and Brahmins)

verses.devanagari:
भृत्यानाम् भरणात् सम्यक् प्रजानाम् परिपालनात् |
अर्थ आदानाच् च धार्मेण पिता नः त्रिदिवम् गतः
verses.iast:
bhṛtyānām bharaṇāt samyak prajānām paripālanāt |
artha ādānāc ca dhārmeṇa pitā naḥ tridivam gataḥ
verses.translation: "Our father reached heaven because he maintained his servants properly, protected his subjects and realised the taxes in the manner prescribed by scriptures from them."

glosses.meaning: in the manner prescribed by scriptures (from them)

verses.devanagari:
कर्मभिस्तु शुभैरिष्टैः क्रतुभिश्चाव्तदक्षिणः |
स्वर्गं दशरथः प्राप्तः पिता नः पृथिवीपतिः
verses.iast:
karmabhistu śubhairiṣṭaiḥ kratubhiścāvtadakṣiṇaḥ |
svargaṃ daśarathaḥ prāptaḥ pitā naḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ
verses.translation: "Our father, the king Dasaratha obtained heaven because of his auspicious acts and perfoming sacrifices involving heavy sacrificial fees."

verses.devanagari:
इष्ट्वा बहुविधैर् यज्नैर् भोगामः च अवाप्य पुष्कलान् |
उत्तमम् च आयुर् आसाद्य स्वर् गतः पृथिवी पतिः
verses.iast:
iṣṭvā bahuvidhair yajnair bhogāmḥ ca avāpya puṣkalān |
uttamam ca āyur āsādya svar gataḥ pṛthivī patiḥ
verses.translation: "Having perfomed many types of sacrifices, enjoying worldly pleasure abundantly and having obtained a long and virtuous life, king Dasaratha reached heaven."

verses.devanagari:
आयुरुत्तममासाद्य भोगानपि च राघवः |
स न शोच्यः पिता तात स्वर्गतः सत्कृतः सताम्
verses.iast:
āyuruttamamāsādya bhogānapi ca rāghavaḥ |
sa na śocyaḥ pitā tāta svargataḥ satkṛtaḥ satām
verses.translation: "O, dear brother! King Dasaratha, our father who was treated with respect by all virtuous men and who secured excellent life-span and enjoyments, is not to be pitied."

verses.devanagari:
स जीर्णम् मानुषम् देहम् परित्यज्य पिता हि नः |
दैवीम् ऋद्धिम् अनुप्राप्तो ब्रह्म लोक विहारिणीम्
verses.iast:
sa jīrṇam mānuṣam deham parityajya pitā hi naḥ |
daivīm ṛddhim anuprāpto brahma loka vihāriṇīm
verses.translation: "King Dasaratha, our father, having abandoned his worn-out human body, indeed has attained the celstial state, by which he can stroll in the realm of Brahma (the highest heaven).

glosses.meaning: indeed has attained daiviim = the celestial
by which he can stroll in thre realm of Brahma ( the highest heaven).

verses.devanagari:
तम् तु न एवम् विधः कश्चित् प्राज्नः शोचितुम् अर्हति |
त्वद् विधो यद् विधः च अपि श्रुतवान् बुद्धिमत्तरः
verses.iast:
tam tu na evam vidhaḥ kaścit prājnaḥ śocitum arhati |
tvad vidho yad vidhaḥ ca api śrutavān buddhimattaraḥ
verses.translation: "No wise, learned and exceptionally clever man, would weep in such a manner, such as I and you, about the emperor.

verses.devanagari:
एते बहु विधाः शोका विलाप रुदिते तथा |
वर्जनीया हि धीरेण सर्व अवस्थासु धीमता
verses.iast:
ete bahu vidhāḥ śokā vilāpa rudite tathā |
varjanīyā hi dhīreṇa sarva avasthāsu dhīmatā
verses.translation: "The wise, who are steadfast, should indeed relinquish these sorrows, lamentatious, weepings and such other states of misery."

verses.devanagari:
स स्वस्थो भव मा शोचो यात्वा च आवस ताम् पुरीम् |
तथा पित्रा नियुक्तो असि वशिना वदतामु वर
verses.iast:
sa svastho bhava mā śoco yātvā ca āvasa tām purīm |
tathā pitrā niyukto asi vaśinā vadatāmu vara
verses.translation: "Be composed, O Most eloquent of orators! Control your grief, return to the City of Ayodhya in order to obey the command of our father, the subduer of his senses."

verses.devanagari:
यत्र अहम् अपि तेन एव नियुक्तः पुण्य कर्मणा |
तत्र एव अहम् करिष्यामि पितुर् आर्यस्य शासनम्
verses.iast:
yatra aham api tena eva niyuktaḥ puṇya karmaṇā |
tatra eva aham kariṣyāmi pitur āryasya śāsanam
verses.translation: "I also will fulfil the command of our father, the venrable man in that very place, whre I have been ordered to stay by that king Dasaratha of virtuous deeds."

verses.devanagari:
न मया शासनम् तस्य त्यक्तुम् न्याय्यम् अरिम् दम |
तत् त्वया अपि सदा मान्यम् स वै बन्धुः स नः पिता
verses.iast:
na mayā śāsanam tasya tyaktum nyāyyam arim dama |
tat tvayā api sadā mānyam sa vai bandhuḥ sa naḥ pitā
verses.translation: "O Bharata the Vanquisher of Foes! It is not justifiable for me to violate the command of our father. You also must honour it to the end, for it comes from our father, out own blood."

glosses.itrans: Bharata the Vanquisher of Foes! na nyaayyam
glosses.iast: Bharata the Vanquiśer of Foes! na nyāyyam
glosses.devanagari: Bहरत थे Vअन्qउइशेर् ओf Fओएस्! न न्याय्यं

verses.devanagari:
तद्वचः पितुरेवाहं सम्मतम् धर्मचारिणः |
कर्मणा पालयिष्यामि वनवासेन राघव
verses.iast:
tadvacaḥ piturevāhaṃ sammatam dharmacāriṇaḥ |
karmaṇā pālayiṣyāmi vanavāsena rāghava
verses.translation: "O, Bharata! Hence, I shall conform to the honourable word of our father, the practiser of virtue, by my act of dwelling in the forest."

verses.devanagari:
धार्मिकेणानृशंसेन नरेण गुरुवर्तिना |
भवितव्यं नरव्याघ्रम् परलोकं जिगीषता
verses.iast:
dhārmikeṇānṛśaṃsena nareṇa guruvartinā |
bhavitavyaṃ naravyāghram paralokaṃ jigīṣatā
verses.translation: O, Tigher among men! Thus should a pious man act, who seeks to harm none, who is obedient to his elders and who aspires to conquer the higher world."

verses.devanagari:
आत्मानमनुतिष्ठ त्वं स्वभावेन नरर्षभ |
निशाम्य तु शुभं वृत्तं पितुर्दशरथस्य नः
verses.iast:
ātmānamanutiṣṭha tvaṃ svabhāvena nararṣabha |
niśāmya tu śubhaṃ vṛttaṃ piturdaśarathasya naḥ
verses.translation: "O, excellent among men! perceiving the virutous conduct of our father, the King Dasaratha, act in conformity to your own nature."

verses.devanagari:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनम् महात्मा|
पितुर्निदेशप्रतिपालनार्थम् |
युवीयसम् भ्रातरमर्थवच्च |
प्रभुर्मुहूर्ताद्विरराम रामः
verses.iast:
ityevamuktvā vacanam mahātmā |
piturnideśapratipālanārtham |
yuvīyasam bhrātaramarthavacca |
prabhurmuhūrtādvirarāma rāmaḥ
verses.translation: Having uttered in about an hour, these meaningful words in this manner to his younger brother on the need of abedience to his father's will, the magnamous and the mighty Rama became silent.

glosses.meaning: ont he need of obedience to his father's will
